description: R14 robustness closure: right-sized resource/soak targets (plan section 'Resource and soak tests -- right-sized'). This file is a CONFIG for a soak runner, not the runner itself -- no runner exists yet; landing the config + a smoke-scale proof of the mechanism (crates/dohc-engine-runtime/tests/soak_r14.rs) is this shard's scope. Building the actual long-running runner (a script that drives these parameters against a real composed daemon, records the metrics below over the full duration, and fits the trend-bound checks) is a deliberate follow-up, tracked on SHARDS.tsv R14 / carried toward GATE6.

smoke.description: PR-gate-sized subset, runs in every `cargo test --workspace` invocation via crates/dohc-engine-runtime/tests/soak_r14.rs. Proves the open/close-returns-actor-count-to-baseline MECHANISM at small scale; does not attempt OS-level thread/handle/RSS measurement.
assertions: WorkspaceSupervisor::actor_count() returns to exactly 0 after every single close
close_all() returns actor_count() to exactly 0 regardless of how many distinct workspace identities were opened

cutoverBlocking.description: The plan's REQUIRED pre-cutover soak (Gate 6 evidence). Not yet automated by a runner script -- this is the target configuration a future R14/R15-adjacent shard's runner script must drive and record results against, pasted into EXECUTION_LOG.md as evidence per the program's convention.
scenarios: plain workspace open/close cycling (the smoke tier's scenario, at full scale)

watcher storms (continuous filesystem change bursts, exercising WATCH_HARD_DEADLINE flush -- see crates/dohc-engine-files/tests/watch.rs::continuous_event_stream_still_flushes_at_the_hard_deadline for the unit-scale version of this scenario)
cancellation storms (many concurrent request cancellations against the protocol Supervisor and the daemon's request-admission path)
editor open/update/close cycles (Y.Doc apply + settle under sustained load)
assertions: threads/OS handles/queue depth return EXACTLY to baseline after all workspaces close (zero unowned handles)
no monotonic RSS slope by simple linear fit over the full duration
queues return to steady state after bursts
workspace close returns owned resources to baseline plus a documented constant
no unbounded WAL/update-log/replication-log/index growth under compaction/retention scenarios
trackedMetrics: SQLite connection count and WAL size
queue depths (protocol Supervisor admission, files actor command queue)
shutdown duration (the daemon drain-before-close path R14 added -- see crates/dohc-workspace-engine/src/bin/dohc-workspace-engine.rs)

postCutoverContinuous.description: Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this shard and for Gate 6 -- the plan places these post-cutover, running continuously during the dogfood window rather than as a cutover-blocking gate ('the founder is the canary and dogfood time is free soak time').
postCutoverContinuous.note: Same trackedMetrics as cutoverBlocking, with statistical trend bounds over the longer window. No runner exists for this tier either; do not build it before the cutoverBlocking tier's runner exists and has produced at least one real result.
